code: native_diff <- function(r_scores, file) {   native <- read.delim(file.path(tip49, file), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)   both <- merge(native, r_scores, by = c("Bait", "Prey"), suffixes = c("_native", "_r"))   vapply(c("AvgP", "MaxP", "SaintScore", "BFDR"), function(column) {     max(abs(both[[paste0(column, "_native")]] - both[[paste0(column, "_r")]]))   }, numeric(1)) } rbind(   spc = native_diff(scores, "list_spc.txt"),   int = native_diff(scores_int, "list_int.txt") ) #>      AvgP  MaxP SaintScore  BFDR #> spc 0.000 0.000      0.000 0.000 #> int 0.001 0.001      0.001 0.016

code: run_saint_eset <- function(eset, bait = "bait", cort = "CorT",                            mode = "spc", ...) {   quant <- Biobase::exprs(eset)   samples <- Biobase::pData(eset)   detected <- which(!is.na(quant) & quant > 0, arr.ind = TRUE)   si <- list(     inter = data.frame(       ipId = colnames(quant)[detected[, 2]],       baitId = samples[[bait]][detected[, 2]],       preyId = rownames(quant)[detected[, 1]],       quant = quant[detected]     ),     prey = data.frame(preyId = rownames(quant)),     bait = data.frame(ipId = colnames(quant), baitId = samples[[bait]],                       CorT = samples[[cort]])   )   scores <- run_saint(si, mode = mode, ...)    baits <- sort(unique(scores$Bait))   cell <- cbind(match(scores$Prey, rownames(quant)), match(scores$Bait, baits))   to_matrix <- function(column) {     m <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow(quant), length(baits),                 dimnames = list(rownames(quant), baits))     m[cell] <- scores[[column]]     m   }   Biobase::ExpressionSet(     assayData = Biobase::assayDataNew(       exprs = to_matrix("AvgP"),       MaxP = to_matrix("MaxP"),       SaintScore = to_matrix("SaintScore"),       FoldChange = to_matrix("FoldChange"),       BFDR = to_matrix("BFDR")     ),     phenoData = Biobase::AnnotatedDataFrame(       data.frame(bait = baits, row.names = baits)     ),     featureData = Biobase::featureData(eset)   ) } counts <- tapply(   si$inter[[4]],   list(factor(si$inter[[3]], levels = si$prey[[1]]),        factor(si$inter[[1]], levels = si$bait[[1]])),   sum ) eset <- Biobase::ExpressionSet(   counts,   phenoData = Biobase::AnnotatedDataFrame(     data.frame(bait = si$bait[[2]], CorT = si$bait[[3]],                row.names = si$bait[[1]])   ) ) eset #>
